harness_version: Claude Code 2.1.251, headless, run inside the task image
argv: cd /workspace && claude -p "$(cat /workspace/instruction.md)" --model claude-opus-4-8 --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions --disallowedTools Agent Task Monitor SendMessage ToolSearch WebFetch WebSearch
environment_note: Same image and same egress restriction as the Codex arm. Run as a non-root user because Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions as root. --disallowedTools enforces the one-agent protocol: an earlier attempt without it spawned 29 subagents and produced no answer.
